plain_summary: Blocked: A1 can't be trusted on this release yet, because measurements are attached to the wrong samples. First step: restore 2 sample profile(s) in protein_rppa.tsv.gz from the baseline release. Compared with frozen-A, release demo-release has 4 clinical label change(s), 1 sample swap(s), 1 profile(s) copied onto other IDs, 1 sample(s) with no clinical record, 1 membership change(s). A1 is Blocked because of F5, F6, F8; A2 is Blocked because of F1, F2, F3, F4. A1 moved 0.46× its sampling noise (within sampling noise); the proposed repairs bring it back to baseline. A2 moved 0.17× its sampling noise (within sampling noise); the proposed repairs bring it back to baseline. Small shifts don't make a release safe: verdicts come from what changed, not how much. A person must review before the new release is used.
